They're coming in from both spawners, cover both of those paths!|audio = PlsDonateWave7.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 7 ([[Pls Donate]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Trader''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Pls Donate]] as part of the [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]]. It had a high amount of health while also being quite fast, faster than the [[Troll]]. It also had 50% defense, reducing damage it received by 33% from most sources. ==Appearance== The '''Trader''' had white skin. It wore a black suit with a red tie. On its back, it carried a Fake Rainbow Periastron. On its head, it wore a Fake Dominus Empyerus and a Fake Domino Crown. It held two fake cash bags in its hands. ==Strategy== *The '''Trader''' has significantly more health than all enemies that appear before it. **Towers with higher DPS, like the [[Minigunner]] or [[Engineer]] can be used, though early game towers like the [[Crook Boss]] or [[Militant]] can still be quite effective. *Defense dropping like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be used to drop its defense. **At later waves, as it spawns in hordes, they can also be used to clear out hordes of them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} TraderWalk.gif|Walking animation (13 November 2024 – 4 December 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} PLSDONATE.png|'''Trader''' on the game thumbnail. PlsDonateBattlepassBoostThumbnail.png|'''Trader''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} PlsDonateThumbnailClean.png|'''Trader''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} PLS DONATE Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Trader''' on a promotional video. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy was based on Roblox limited item traders. **The dominus it wore, {{RLinkC|21070012|Dominus Empyreus}}, is one of the most expensive limiteds on the platform. **The crown it wore is {{RLinkC|1031429|Domino Crown}}, one of the most expensive limiteds on the platform. **On its back, it had the {{RLinkC|159229806|Rainbow Periastron Omega}}, a limited gear, though it is the cheapest out of the three it wears. **It also held two {{RLinkC|16722267|Moneybag}} gears, though these are not limiteds. ==Update History== *'''13 November 2024''' - [[v1.41.0]] **'''Trader''' added. **{{Bug}} [[Jester]]'s defense dropping does not reduce '''Trader's''' defense. *'''4 December 2024''' - [[v1.44.0]] **'''Trader''' removed. {{PlsDonate|[[Troll]]|Wave 4|Trader|Wave 7|[[Cat]]|Wave 8}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
